snippet.title: Blokkan: Secret of the Walking City - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Solve a grand mystery atop a gigantic walking city in Blokkan: Secret of the Walking City! Gather clues, meet eccentric characters, and solve playful puzzles in an unforgettable adventure. Currently in development with the proud support of Team Cherry Presents.

Creator introduction: https://youtu.be/IOofDpnaxzg
Wishlist the game on Steam: http://blokkangame.com/
